notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI implements the client-side pending-operation lock including Benilla's deliberate widening: _pendingBagLocks records the (guid, stack count) baseline for both ends of a move at send time (AddPendingBagLock on carried source + destination), IsInventorySlotLocked greys/disables the covered slots, and ObserveBagLocks clears an entry when the slot's current guid OR count diverges from the baseline - the same resolving field-update watch that catches same-guid split-merges.
